[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Revelation (revelation-greek). The verses the casting arrives at (9:13–9:16):

**9:13** Καὶ ὁ ἕκτος ἄγγελος ἐσάλπισεν· καὶ ἤκουσα φωνὴν μίαν ἐκ ⸀τῶν κεράτων τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τοῦ χρυσοῦ τοῦ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ,

**9:14** ⸀λέγοντα τῷ ἕκτῳ ἀγγέλῳ, ὁ ἔχων τὴν σάλπιγγα· Λῦσον τοὺς τέσσαρας ἀγγέλους τοὺς δεδεμένους ἐπὶ τῷ ποταμῷ τῷ μεγάλῳ Εὐφράτῃ.

**9:15** καὶ ἐλύθησαν οἱ τέσσαρες ἄγγελοι οἱ ἡτοιμασμένοι εἰς τὴν ὥραν ⸀καὶ ἡμέραν καὶ μῆνα καὶ ἐνιαυτόν, ἵνα ἀποκτείνωσιν τὸ τρίτον τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

**9:16** καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν στρατευμάτων τοῦ ⸀ἱππικοῦ ⸀δισμυριάδες μυριάδων· ἤκουσα τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν.

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «what season is this?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The casting arrives at the sixth trumpet — not the last, not the first: the sixth. A voice from the horns of the golden altar speaks one command, and four angels bound at the Euphrates are loosed, and two hundred million cavalry ride. What the rotation opens is the axis of the season itself: this passage does not ask whether destruction comes, it asks when — εἰς τὴν ὥραν καὶ ἡμέραν καὶ μῆνα καὶ ἐνιαυτόν, for the hour and day and month and year, prepared from before the witness ever asked. The question «what season is this?» lands in a text that holds the terrifying answer: the season is the one that was always set. The rite will traverse these verses through the rotation's succession of axes — what cost is borne in the loosing, what the bound angels lose when they are freed, what the numbers are hiding from the army they name. The rotation is open. Rebekah Cranes holds the first transform.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:00D8"}}]}
